# Pasteport — Complete AI Knowledge Base & Technical Overview

Site URL: https://pasteport.zain-imran.com
Creator: Zain Imran
Technology Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Firebase Firestore, Cloudflare R2, Web Crypto API

## Positioning & Mission
**Pasteport — Cross-Device Sharing + Developer Toolkit**

Pasteport bridges the gap between frictionless cross-device clipboard sharing and an expansive suite of 18 client-side developer workflow utilities. It eliminates the friction of moving text, code snippets, photos, PDFs, or files from one device to another (such as from a smartphone to a work PC) without requiring login, email, messaging apps, or cloud storage accounts. Every developer utility runs 100% in browser memory and connects directly to Pasteport for instant 1-click sharing.

## Core Sharing Capabilities

### 1. 6-Digit Share Codes, Links & QR Codes
- Content is keyed by a randomly generated 6-digit numeric code (e.g. `482910`).
- Receivers access content via `/read` by entering the code or navigating to `https://pasteport.zain-imran.com/view/<code>`.
- Share cards render an inline QR code, with a modal offering full-screen display, high-res PNG export ("Save QR"), and native mobile sharing.

### 2. Camera QR Scanner & Mobile Offline Downloads
- Reader page (`/read`) includes an interactive HTML5 camera scanner with live viewfinder and reticle, plus photo gallery fallback.
- Client-side IndexedDB caching (`pasteport_offline_db`) allows users to toggle "Save Offline", preserving text, metadata, and binary file blobs as Data URLs for offline access and downloads without network connectivity.

### 3. 4-Character Access PIN Protection
- Senders can protect any share with a 4-character PIN.
- Can be toggled before code generation or changed dynamically at runtime on the share card.
- Reader screens lock instantly in real time via Firestore snapshot listeners if PIN protection is toggled on.

### 4. Self-Destruct PIN & Instant Data Wipe
- Senders can configure a secret deletion PIN.
- The Self-Destruct button is displayed right below the code digits and only visible on the reader side if configured.
- When confirmed, all Firestore metadata and Cloudflare R2 objects are permanently and immediately wiped.

### 5. Custom Lifespan & Instant Auto-Expiry
- 1, 3, 6, 12, or 24-hour lifespans (default: 24h).
- Expired content is purged immediately from storage upon access or via automated cleanup cron (`/api/cron/cleanup`).

### 6. Seamless Clipboard Paste (Ctrl + V)
- Users can press `Ctrl + V` anywhere on the page to paste clipboard images or text directly.
- Files up to 10MB (or up to 600MB via `/secure`) are sandboxed in Cloudflare R2 object storage.

## Complete Developer Utilities Suite (18 Tools · 100% Client-Side)
Every tool operates in browser memory with zero server data leakage and includes a 1-click "Share via Pasteport" button:
1. **JSON Formatter & Tree Inspector (`/json`)**: Beautify, minify, validate, and explore nested JSON payloads with a collapsible tree inspector.
2. **YAML ↔ JSON Converter (`/yaml`)**: Bi-directional conversion between YAML and JSON with live syntax error detection.
3. **SQL Formatter & Beautifier (`/sql`)**: Beautify queries, uppercase keywords, customize indentations, and minify SQL.
4. **HTML Formatter & Preview (`/html`)**: Beautify/minify HTML with split-screen sandboxed DOM rendering.
5. **Diff Checker (`/diff`)**: Side-by-side and unified text/code comparison with syntax difference highlighting.
6. **Markdown Live Editor (`/markdown`)**: Split-screen live preview with GitHub Flavored Markdown and PDF/HTML export.
7. **Base64 & URL Converter (`/encode`)**: Convert text, query parameters, and binary files into Data URIs.
8. **Regex Tester & Matcher (`/regex`)**: Real-time regex testing with match highlighter, capture group inspector, and common regex presets.
9. **UUID & GUID Generator (`/uuid`)**: Generate RFC 4122 (v4) and RFC 9562 (v7) UUIDs in bulk with custom casing, hyphens, and braces.
10. **Unix Timestamp Converter (`/timestamp`)**: Live ticking epoch clock with bi-directional seconds/ms conversion, ISO-8601, RFC 2822, and relative time offsets.
11. **Cron Expression Generator (`/cron`)**: 5-field interactive schedule builder, plain English schedule explainer, and next 5 execution times calculator.
12. **Lorem Ipsum & Dummy JSON Generator (`/lorem`)**: Generate placeholder text (paragraphs, sentences, words) or mock structured JSON datasets (Users, Products, Posts, Orders).
13. **JWT Debugger & Decoder (`/jwt`)**: Inspect JWT headers and payload claims with live expiry countdowns.
14. **JWT Generator & Signer (`/jwt-gen`)**: Construct claims and cryptographically sign HMAC-SHA256/384/512 tokens using browser Web Crypto APIs.
15. **Cryptographic Hash Generator (`/hash`)**: Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, and HMAC signatures for text and local files.
16. **URL Parser & Query Editor (`/url`)**: Deconstruct URLs, inspect components, and edit query parameter keys and values in real time.
17. **HTTP Status Code Reference (`/http-status`)**: Searchable encyclopedia of standard RFC and Cloudflare HTTP status codes with troubleshooting tips.
18. **Color Converter & Contrast (`/color`)**: Convert HEX, RGB, HSL, RGBA, calculate WCAG 2.1 accessibility contrast ratios, and generate tints & shades.

## Native Desktop App & Developer CLI

### Pasteport Desktop (`/desktop`)
- Native desktop applications for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- Global Hotkey (`Ctrl + Shift + P` / `Cmd + Shift + P`) to summon the quick-share HUD from any application.
- Background system tray daemon, clipboard monitoring mode, and native OS notifications.
- Complete offline-first developer utilities suite embedded natively.

### Pasteport CLI (`/cli`)
- Zero-dependency Node.js and Python command-line interface (`npm i -g pasteport-zisphere`, `pip install pasteport-zisphere`, or `npx pasteport-zisphere`).
- `pasteport send "text"`: Upload text snippet and receive 6-digit code.
- `cat file.txt | pasteport send`: Pipe terminal outputs or CI logs directly to Pasteport.
- `pasteport send ./build.zip`: Upload archives or binaries directly to Cloudflare R2 storage.
- `pasteport get <code>`: Retrieve text or download binary files locally (`-o ./downloaded.zip`).
- Flags: `-p, --pin <4-char>`, `-e, --expiry <hours>`, `-d, --self-destruct`, `--raw`, `--json`.

## Developer Hub
- URL: `https://pasteport.zain-imran.com/tools`
- Categorized and searchable directory of all 18 developer utilities.
